title: Understanding the Design Matrix
text: The design matrix $X$ includes all the features and the intercept term for each flight record. Consider how many records and features are present.

title: Number of Rows in $X$
text: The number of rows in the design matrix corresponds to the number of flight records. How many records are there?

title: Number of Columns in $X$
text: The number of columns in the design matrix corresponds to the number of features plus one for the intercept. How many features are there?

title: Calculate the Shape of $X$
text: Combine the number of rows and columns to determine the shape of the design matrix $X$.
